games.title: CubeX - Solver, Timer, 3D Cube
games.description:
What is CubeX - Solver, Timer, 3D Cube?

🧩 Find a solution for a scrambled 3x3 cube, explore patterns and practice with a virtual cube on Android. This cube solver combines camera and manual input with step-by-step guidance, two solving approaches and a timer for your practice sessions.

Enter the cube in front of you or experiment on screen. Offline cube solving lets you keep practicing when you are away from an internet connection.

Who is CubeX - Solver, Timer, 3D Cube for?

Use it when you are stuck on a scrambled cube and want to follow the moves back to a solved state. If you are learning the Fridrich method, also called CFOP, choose that solver to practice the approach with your own cube state.

For regular cubing practice, switch between timed solves, pattern challenges and the virtual 3D cube. Try an algorithm on screen or explore a different pattern without needing to turn a physical cube.

What does CubeX - Solver, Timer, 3D Cube do?

• Camera and manual input: scan your cube's colors or fill in its faces using the color picker. Camera input includes color calibration controls.
• Fridrich Solver: follow a solution based on the CFOP method to learn and practice this solving approach.
• Advanced Solver: generate a solution for a valid 3x3 cube using Herbert Kociemba's Two-Phase Algorithm.
• Pattern Solver: find moves between valid starting and target patterns. Explore predefined designs, such as checkerboards and stripes, or create custom patterns.
• Virtual 3D cube: practice algorithms and apply patterns on screen. Use the Fridrich or Advanced Solver within the virtual cube, with scramble and reset controls for further practice.
• Solve timer: measure your solve times with competition-style timing as part of your practice routine.

How does CubeX - Solver, Timer, 3D Cube work?

Choose Manual Input or Camera Input and enter the colors of your cube. For camera scanning, allow camera access and use the calibration controls as needed. Check that the entered colors match the physical cube before generating a solution, then follow the steps in order.

Choose the Fridrich or Advanced Solver according to how you want to practice. To explore a design instead, open Pattern Solver and select a target pattern. Open Virtual Cube for on-screen practice, or Cube Timer when you want to time a solve.

Compatibility and requirements

The solver is designed for valid 3x3 cube states. Accurate color input matters: a state that does not match your physical cube will not give you the right sequence for that cube. Camera scanning requires a working camera and camera access; manual input provides an alternative.

Cube solving works offline. The app contains ads and offers in-app purchases. Use competition-style timing to structure your own practice sessions.

CubeX - Solver, Timer, 3D Cube brings guided solutions, pattern exploration and timed practice together so you can work with a physical puzzle or a virtual cube in one place.

games.title: ASolver>I'll solve your puzzle
games.description:
Take a photo of your Magic Cube with the camera and see how to solve the puzzle.

The 100 patterns on the Magic Cube will not leave you indifferent.

Incredible Feature! Some puzzles have been broken - disassembled and reassembled incorrectly. Such puzzles are impossible to solve. ASolver knows how to solve and fix such a puzzle.

The app uses the camera to recognize and solve puzzles:
 - 3x3x3 Magic Cube (Speed Cube, Puzzle Cube)
 - 2x2x2 Pocket Cube (Mini Cube)
 - 4x4x4 Rubik's Revenge (Master Cube)
 - 5x5x5 Professor's Cube
 - 6x6x6 V-Cube 6
 - Pyraminx (Meffet's Pyramid)
 - Megaminx
 - Void Cube
 - Skewb
 - 1x2x3 Puzzle 123
 - 2x3x3 Domino
 - Ivy Cube
 - Kilominx without centers
 - Kilominx with centers  
 - Dino Cube
 - 2x2x3 Tower
new puzzles will be ready soon.

Scan the puzzle with your camera and ASolver will walk you through the steps to solve it in minutes!

You can solve the puzzle by looking at the interactive model. Or see a list of moves that solve the puzzle.

The camera is not always able to recognize the puzzle, for example in poor lighting or due to glare. This is not a problem - the puzzle can easily be entered in manual mode.

For simple puzzles (2x2x2, 2x2x3, 2x3x3, 1x2x3, Skewb, Ivy, Pyraminx, Dino) ASolver finds the optimal solution with the minimum possible number of moves.

The solution of the 3x3x3 Magic Cube and the 3x3x3 Void Cube is very close to optimal. For a well tangled puzzle, that's about 19 moves.

For 4x4x4, 5x5x5, Kilominx with and without centers, and Megaminx the optimal solution is unknown, so nobody knows :)

A well-tangled:
 - 4x4x4 on average is solved in 48 moves
 - 5x5x5 in 83 moves
 - Kilominx with centers in 35 moves

ASolver is the solution to any puzzle.
